:'''Solo''': ''"Corellian Overdrive is doing whatever you need to do to get where you need to go, Threepio. Including finagling the rules&mdash;"''<br />'''Organa''': ''"'Lying.'"''<br />'''Solo''': ''"&mdash;rejiggering the operational parameters&mdash;"''<br />'''Calrissian''': ''"'Stacking the deck.'"''<br />'''Solo''': ''"Hey, Corellian Overdrive doesn't mean cheating in an honest game."''<br />'''Calrissian''': ''"I seem to recall some angry cardplayers who saw it differently, Han."<br />&mdash;''Han Solo, Leia Organa, and Lando Calrissian''<sup class="noprint">[[Prophecies and Destinies|''[src]'']]</sup>

"'''Corellian Overdrive'''" was an idiom that [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] used; it meant going to whatever lengths necessary to achieve something.
